redistribution: Raw credit CSV/ASC/ZIP, applicant IDs, acquisition locks, features, test predictions and outcomes remain local. Only source URLs, byte hashes, aggregate progress, protocol, code and old synthetic diagnostic evidence are public.
SouthGermanCredit: One corrected German-credit benchmark; UCI aliases are not independent tasks. 0=bad,1=good; bad=1 in M5. Amount is transformed and not currency loss.
LendingClub2017: Terminal Fully Paid/Charged Off snapshot subset only, later than the prior 2014/2015/2016 development cohorts. Public funded-loan masking cannot identify true reject counterfactuals; final status lacks actual availability timestamps.
receipt_outcome_flag_scope: outcome_values_inspected=false records receipt time before registration/training; subsequent legal training labels have been used. Sealed-T evaluation has not run.
